title: Receptionist til vores rejseklinik i Aalborg - ferieafløser.
description:
Sætter du en ære i at skabe god stemning og levere service på højt plan ? Vil du gerne arbejde et sted, hvor du gør en forskel?
Så er det måske dig vi mangler!
Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service A/S har travlt, og derfor søger vi receptionister til timelønnet arbejde i vores klinik i Aalborg.
Vores kunder kommer til klinikerne i forbindelse med vaccination før udlandsrejse samt diverse andre vacciner, fx TBE, influenzavacciner og børnevacciner.
Receptionistrollen er en utrolig vigtig funktion, idet du vil være det første venlige ansigt som vores kunder møder, når de ankommer til vores klinikker. Hos os er dette især vigtigt, da visse af vores kunder kan være en smule spændte inden de bliver vaccineret, og her vil du med dit smil og venlige og imødekommende service være med til at give dem en god oplevelse.
Vi har som udgangspunkt brug for din indsats mindst 4 timer pr uge, med stor mulighed for forlængelse og flere timer.
Stillingen er til besættelse fra 1. juli - 1. september og du skal kunne arbejde alle ugerne i denne periode.
Dine arbejdsopgaver
Dine primære opgaver vil være:
Tage imod og ankomst registrere kunderne
Tage imod betaling
Besvare telefonhenvendelser
Andre ad hoc-opgaver
Om dig
Som person er du imødekommende, udadvendt og er det venlige ansigt, som vores kunder møder, når de ankommer til vores klinikker. Derudover:
Har du let til smil
Vægter du kundeservice højt
Er du fleksibel og imødekommende
Er du fortrolige med brug af IT
Kan du arbejde selvstændigt og prioritere de forskellige opgaver
Forstår du vigtigheden af at indgå i en servicefunktion – herunder være mødestabil og loyal
Vi tilbyder
Grundig oplæring i jobbet som receptionist
Timeløn (hverdage 8-19:30) 135 kr./time
Tillæg aften samt lørdag 15 kr./time
Tillæg søndag 25 kr./time
Hvem er vi
Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service blev etableret i 1998 med det erklærede mål at forbygge sygdom gennem større udbredelse af vaccinationer.
I dag er selskabet Danmarks største udbyder af vaccinationer. Vi er ca. 250 læger og sygeplejersker der forestår vaccinationerne.
I samarbejde med kommuner, patientforeninger og virksomheder har Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service indtil videre:
Planlagt og gennemført mere end 20.000 vaccinationsarrangementer mod influenza.
Vaccineret mere end 3 mio. danske borgere.
Vaccineret mere end 50.000 immobile borgere i deres eget hjem.
Desuden servicerer vi årligt ca. 1.200 danske virksomheder, som tilbyder deres ansatte en forebyggende vaccination mod influenza.
Gennem vores landsdækkende netværk af klinikker tilbyder Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service også vaccination i forbindelse med rejse til udlandet. Vi vaccinerer årligt mere end 40.000 personer i forbindelse med rejsevaccination.
Mere end 40 af Danmarks største rejsebureauer samarbejder aktivt med Danske Lægers Vaccination Service, for at sikre at alle rejsende er ordentligt beskyttet og vaccineret inden de begiver sig ud i verden.
I 2007 etablerede vi os også i England, under navnet European Vaccination Group UK Ltd. I England servicerer vi offentlige og private virksomheder, ligesom vi i samarbejde med National Health Service (NHS) gennemfører en række vaccinationsarrangementer på skoler i flere kommuner. Desuden driver selskabet også en række klinikker hvor der blandt andet tilbydes rejsevaccination.
Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service er en del af European LifeCare Group A/S.
Spørgsmål til jobbet sendes til:
charlotte.christiansen@dlvs.dk
Vil du gerne søge jobbet, så send en motiveret ansøgning samt dit CV via knappen forneden (vi modtager ikke ansøgninger via email).

title: Vaccinatør til vores rejseklinik i Thisted (4-7 timer)
description:

Du kommer til at have en varieret hverdag, hvor du både rådgiver og vaccinerer kunder i forbindelse med udlandsrejser samt diverse andre vacciner, fx TBE, influenzavacciner og børnevacciner.

har erfaring med rådgivning og at vaccinere eller har lyst til at tilegne sig dette
har erfaring med akutbehandling

ønsker at tilegne dig ny viden, samt at anvende denne
er fortrolig med brug af IT
er fleksibel og gerne hjælper til ved sygdom, ferie mv.
Vi tilbyder
grundig oplæring i at vaccinere og den tilhørende rådgivning samt akutbehandling.
mulighed for at tilegne dig praktisk erfaring med rådgivning og vaccinationer

title: HR Manager, The Netherlands
description:
Location: Haarlem
Company: Vaccinaties op reis B.V. part of European LifeCare Group
European LifeCare Group (ELCG) is a leading provider of vaccination clinics and on-site vaccination programmes across Europe. We are seeking an experienced and commercially minded HR Manager for the Netherlands to lead our HR operations across Vaccinaties op reis B.V. and PreventVaccins.
This is a fantastic opportunity to make a significant impact in a fast-growing, purpose-driven company with a mission to save lives through vaccination.
About the Role
As a member of the Dutch management team and reporting to the Group CHRO, you will be driving local HR activities that support business performance, employee engagement, and operational excellence in close corporation with senior leadership.
The role also has European responsibility for a HR key process for the company which gives you the opportunity to work with stakeholders across our markets and drive business critical improvements e.g. onboarding of employees in all countries.
Key Responsibilities
Provide tactical and hands-on support to managers across the full employee lifecycle—from onboarding to offboarding—including employee engagement, HR policies, compensation and benefits, and employee relations.
Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, contributing to a culture of growth, and high performance.
Lead, coach, and inspire HR colleagues, fostering trust, ownership, and professional development. You will have one HR colleague reporting to you from the local HR team.
HR process ownership for ELCG on onboarding of employees across all our countries in Europe
Implement group-level HR initiatives at a local level, including concepts within engagement, learning & development, talent acquisition, systems, performance management, and onboarding.
Ensure legal compliance and uphold best practices in employment law and internal policies.
About You
You are a seasoned HR leader with a proven ability to manage and motivate teams in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
You are a natural collaborator building strong relationships across departments and with key stakeholders.
You bring experience leading HR operations.
You hold a master’s degree, with strong knowledge of employment law and HR compliance.
You’re a self-starter with a flexible mindset and a solution-oriented approach to challenges and change.
Your leadership style is approachable and people-focused, with a strong sense of accountability and a desire to drive meaningful impact.
You speak Dutch and English at business level
What We Offer
A key leadership role in a company with a life-saving mission and rapid growth trajectory
Competitive salary, dependent on experience
Possibilities to combine a local HR Manager role with HR responsibilities across European countries
Interested?
For further information, please contact Bettina Buch, Group CHRO, at +45 30 77 32 30
Application deadline: 26 April 2026. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply early.
European LifeCare Group is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, religion, sex, origin, age, disabilities, genetic information, marital status, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Clinical Lead - Vaccination UK
description:
ABOUT US:
Are you ready to be part of an organisation that makes a real impact and values innovation? Do you want to join a supportive team all working toward protecting schoolchildren from preventable diseases? If you're looking for a role within the field of immunisation where you can grow your leadership skills and help guide a team of nurses toward achieving this important goal, keep reading.
Vaccination UK delivers the school-aged immunisation programme for NHS England across large areas of England, including all of North London. Our mission is to protect the next generation from serious diseases like HPV, influenza, polio, and meningitis. If you’re passionate about making a difference and want to be part of this important work, we’d love to hear from you!
We currently have a vacancy for an experienced Clinical Lead Nurse in
Hertforshire
. You’ll be joining a friendly, supportive team where no two days are the same. In this community-based role, you’ll work in schools and local communities, mentoring junior staff and leading a team of nurses to ensure they work safely and effectively. You’ll play a key role in increasing the uptake of vaccinations in this age group. You’ll be well-supported by a growing network of Clinical Leads from across England and the Clinical Director, ensuring you have the autonomy to manage your role while always having the support you need to excel.
Our mission is to fight disease and save lives by making prevention and treatment easy, accessible and safe.
JOB DETAILS:
Job title:
Clinical Lead.
Contract:
Fixed Term until 31.10.2026
Working Hours:
08:30 – 16:30
, Monday to Friday (but we're happy to be flexible and review this for the right candidate)
BENEFITS:
Pension - 5% employer contribution based on qualified earnings.
VIVUP - Supermarket & High Street Discounts & Employee Assistant Programme.
Blue Light Card - Supermarket & High Street Discounts.
Employee referral scheme.
25 days annual leave.
WHAT YOU'LL DO:
The postholder will be responsible for ensuring Vaccination UK’s immunisation programme is
compliant
with CQC guidance in accordance with the fundamental standards, and immunisation nurses work to a high clinical standard.
WHO YOU'LL BE:
Ensure
school-aged children who are vaccinated within the program are treated professionally and that patient safety is prioritised.
Monitor
vaccination programmes to ensure they are running safely and to high clinical standards.
Support management
in delivering the vaccination programme by maintaining regular contact with clinical staff to ensure they are working within Vaccination UK policies and standards.
Address safeguarding concerns
raised by nurses, escalate to the Clinical Director and attend quarterly supervision provided by Vaccination UK.
Act as the
primary contact
for nurses regarding any clinical queries or safeguarding concerns raised by staff.
Provide
support
to Senior Management for all compliance related matters, ensuring that we operate according to regulations.
Manage recruitment and induction for your respective areas. Ensure new staff have compliant vaccination records.
Ensure accurate and comprehensive record keeping for all formal and informal clinical supervision, staff training/ recruitment, incidents and complaints to comply with CQC standards.
Participate in
CQC
inspections as required.
Conduct annual performance development review for clinical staff, assessing clinical competencies and ensuring that clinical staff undertake a comprehensive clinical induction.
Document
training and support sessions according to Vaccination UK standards and requirements.
Work with Senior Management to ensure
accurate recording
of clinical incidents and complaints, allocate investigating officers appropriately, and complete outcome forms.
Act as a
liaison
with Senior Management to ensure organisational learning and patient safety are optimised.
Assist in
recruiting
nursing staff and allocating
mentors
for new nursing staff, as well as undertaking the induction process for new staff.
Attend relevant meetings as requested.
Plan and implement
formal clinical supervision sessions with immunisation nurses at a minimum interval of every three months.
Undertake other duties commensurate with the level of this position.
Comply with Company policies & procedures.
EXPERIENCE/SKILLS:
NMC registered.
Nursing Quilification
Safeguarding trained.
Immunisation (essential).
Managerial / Leadership.
Excellent interpersonal skills.
Effective Communication with different colleagues at different levels.
Efficiently manage documentation and record-keeping (essential).
Good IT skills.
High levels of competence, judgement, integrity, personal and professional accountability.
If you're looking for a role where your experience in immunisations can make a real difference, we’d love to have you join our team!
European LifeCare Group is committed to providing equal opportunities to all applicants, regardless of race, religion, sex, origin, age, disabilities, genetic information, marital status, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Area Manager, Copenhagen
description:
You don’t just lead people, you run a business.
We’re looking for an Area Manager who takes real ownership – of people, operations, and results.
In this role you are not on the sidelines, you are in the middle of it - responsible for clinics, performance, and engagement.
You lead at a distance and understand that it requires clarity, presence, and direction and you know that leadership isn’t something you talk about, but It’s something you do.
If you’re motivated by creating structure, developing people, and driving results in an organisation in motion – then read on.
As an Area Manager at European LifeCare Group, you will in Denmark operate under the brand "Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service".
You will report to the Director of DK Private.
About the job:
The key responsibilities as an Area Manager in Danske Lægers VaccinationsService include:
People Management
Lead and develop clinic staff remotely, ensuring a high level of engagement, performance, and alignment across locations
Act as owner of national processes, ensuring consistency and continuous improvement across clinics in collaboration with your Area Manager colleagues
Ensure adherence to the company’s leadership principles and expectations
Own workforce planning and scheduling across clinics, including forecasting staffing needs within your area together wih your administrative coordinator
Manage end-to-end recruitment processes and onboarding of new employees
Drive professional development within the area, including supervision, journal audits, and follow-up on e-learning completion
Ensure implementation and adherence to company concepts, standards, and new initiatives
Promote employee well-being and engagement through active use of the company’s engagement platform
Operations
Hold full responsibility for the day-to-day operations of clinics within your area
Drive performance management in close collaboration with Marketing
Monitor, follow up on, and continuously improve key KPIs
Ensure compliance with guidelines for clinic setup and physical environment
Ensure optimal clinic locations to support accessibility, growth, and performance
Budget & Financial Management
Contribute to the development of clinic-level budgets
Continuously update and refine performance forecasts for clinics
Follow up on budgets and forecasts in close collaboration with Finance
Take ownership of clinic revenue performance, including adjusting opening hours in line with demand
About you
Professional Qualifications
Proven experience with remote people management
Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into action
Experience working with KPIs and performance metrics
Fluent in Danish and English, both written and spoken
Solid commercial understanding
Experience managing multiple locations simultaneously
Personal Competencies
Strong leadership and communication skills
Ability to maintain a holistic overview while managing operational details
An attentive and inclusive leadership style
Highly organized and structured
Results-oriented with a strong drive to deliver impact
Self-driven, proactive, and able to take ownership
Positive, solution-oriented, and adaptable in a dynamic environment
About us
European Lifecare Group is Europe’s largest provider of influenza and travel vaccinations, operating through a network of private vaccination clinics and public immunisation programmes.
We were founded in 1998 under the name “Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service” and expanded to the UK in 2007, where we have acquired several companies and now operate under multiple brands – in Denmark under “Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service”.
We have clinics across most of Denmark and in the UK, and we work with both the Danish and British healthcare systems as a contracted service provider for school immunisation programmes and national influenza vaccination programmes.
Since our founding in 1998, we have vaccinated more than 5 million customers.
Practical information:
Desired start date: As soon as possible
Working hours: 37.5 hours per week
Application deadline: 24th of April 2026. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, and the position will be filled once the right candidate has been found.

title: Receptionist til vores rejseklinik i Kolding (timelønnet)
description:
Sætter du en ære i at skabe god stemning og levere service på højt plan ? Vil du gerne arbejde et sted, hvor du gør en forskel?
Så er det måske dig vi mangler!
Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service A/S har travlt, og derfor søger vi receptionister til timelønnet arbejde i vores klinikker i hele Danmark. Vores kunder kommer til klinikerne i forbindelse med vaccination før udlandsrejse samt diverse andre vacciner, fx TBE, influenzavacciner og børnevacciner.
Receptionistrollen er en utrolig vigtig funktion, idet du vil være det første venlige ansigt som vores kunder møder, når de ankommer til vores klinikker. Hos os er dette især vigtigt, da visse af vores kunder kan være en smule spændte inden de bliver vaccineret, og her vil du med dit smil og venlige og imødekommende service være med til at give dem en god oplevelse.
Vi har som udgangspunkt brug for din indsats onsdag kl. 15.30-19.30. Der vil derudover blive mulighed for at tage ekstra vagter ved sygdom og ferie, evt. også i andre klinikker.
Dine arbejdsopgaver
Dine primære opgaver vil være:
Tage imod og ankomstregistrerer kunderne
Tage imod betaling
Besvare telefonhenvendelser
Andre ad hoc-opgaver
Om dig
Som person er du imødekommende, udadvendt og er det venlige ansigt, som vores kunder møder, når de ankommer til vores klinikker. Derudover:
Har du let til smil
Vægter du kundeservice højt
Er du fleksibel og imødekommende
Er du fortrolige med brug af IT
Kan du arbejde selvstændigt og prioritere de forskellige opgaver
Forstår du vigtigheden af at indgå i en servicefunktion – herunder være mødestabil og loyal
Vi tilbyder
Grundig oplæring i jobbet som receptionist
Timeløn (hverdage 8-19:30) 135 kr./time
Tillæg aften samt lørdag 15 kr./time
Tillæg søndag 25 kr./time
Hvem er vi
Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service blev etableret i 1998 med det erklærede mål at forbygge sygdom gennem større udbredelse af vaccinationer.
I dag er selskabet Danmarks største udbyder af vaccinationer. Vi er ca. 250 læger og sygeplejersker der forestår vaccinationerne.
I samarbejde med kommuner, patientforeninger og virksomheder har Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service indtil videre:
Planlagt og gennemført mere end 20.000 vaccinationsarrangementer mod influenza.
Vaccineret mere end 3 mio. danske borgere.
Vaccineret mere end 50.000 immobile borgere i deres eget hjem.
Desuden servicerer vi årligt ca. 1.200 danske virksomheder, som tilbyder deres ansatte en forebyggende vaccination mod influenza.
Gennem vores landsdækkende netværk af klinikker tilbyder Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service også vaccination i forbindelse med rejse til udlandet. Vi vaccinerer årligt mere end 40.000 personer i forbindelse med rejsevaccination.
Mere end 40 af Danmarks største rejsebureauer samarbejder aktivt med Danske Lægers Vaccination Service, for at sikre at alle rejsende er ordentligt beskyttet og vaccineret inden de begiver sig ud i verden.
I 2007 etablerede vi os også i England, under navnet European Vaccination Group UK Ltd. I England servicerer vi offentlige og private virksomheder, ligesom vi i samarbejde med National Health Service (NHS) gennemfører en række vaccinationsarrangementer på skoler i flere kommuner. Desuden driver selskabet også en række klinikker hvor der blandt andet tilbydes rejsevaccination.
Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service er en del af European Life Care Group A/S.

Receptionistrollen er en utrolig vigtig funktion, idet du vil være det første venlige ansigt som vores kunder møder, når de ankommer til vores klinikker. Hos os er dette især vigtigt, da visse af vores kunder kan være en smule spændte inden de bliver vaccineret, og her vil du med dit smil og venlige og imødekommende service være med til at give dem en god oplevelse.
Vi har som udgangspunkt brug for din indsats 10 timer pr uge (mandag og torsdag fra 15.30 - 20.30)
Dine arbejdsopgaver
Dine primære opgaver vil være:
Tage imod og ankomst registrere kunderne
Tage imod betaling
Besvare telefonhenvendelser
Andre ad hoc-opgaver
Om dig
Som person er du imødekommende, udadvendt og er det venlige ansigt, som vores kunder møder, når de ankommer til vores klinikker. Derudover:
Har du let til smil
Vægter du kundeservice højt
Er du fleksibel og imødekommende
Er du fortrolige med brug af IT
Kan du arbejde selvstændigt og prioritere de forskellige opgaver
Forstår du vigtigheden af at indgå i en servicefunktion – herunder være mødestabil og loyal
Vi tilbyder
Grundig oplæring i jobbet som receptionist
Timeløn (hverdage 8-19:30) 135 kr./time
Tillæg aften samt lørdag 15 kr./time
Tillæg søndag 25 kr./time
Hvem er vi
Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service blev etableret i 1998 med det erklærede mål at forbygge sygdom gennem større udbredelse af vaccinationer.
I dag er selskabet Danmarks største udbyder af vaccinationer. Vi er ca. 250 læger og sygeplejersker der forestår vaccinationerne.
I samarbejde med kommuner, patientforeninger og virksomheder har Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service indtil videre:
Planlagt og gennemført mere end 20.000 vaccinationsarrangementer mod influenza.
Vaccineret mere end 3 mio. danske borgere.
Vaccineret mere end 50.000 immobile borgere i deres eget hjem.
Desuden servicerer vi årligt ca. 1.200 danske virksomheder, som tilbyder deres ansatte en forebyggende vaccination mod influenza.
Gennem vores landsdækkende netværk af klinikker tilbyder Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service også vaccination i forbindelse med rejse til udlandet. Vi vaccinerer årligt mere end 40.000 personer i forbindelse med rejsevaccination.
Mere end 40 af Danmarks største rejsebureauer samarbejder aktivt med Danske Lægers Vaccination Service, for at sikre at alle rejsende er ordentligt beskyttet og vaccineret inden de begiver sig ud i verden.
I 2007 etablerede vi os også i England, under navnet European Vaccination Group UK Ltd. I England servicerer vi offentlige og private virksomheder, ligesom vi i samarbejde med National Health Service (NHS) gennemfører en række vaccinationsarrangementer på skoler i flere kommuner. Desuden driver selskabet også en række klinikker hvor der blandt andet tilbydes rejsevaccination.
Danske Lægers Vaccinations Service er en del af European LifeCare Group A/S.
